_doc: THE ONE FIELD NO HASH CAN DERIVE. tools/inbox_manifest.py computes every other column on the page — md5, sha256, size, arrival date, and which canonical copy the file became. WHY a file arrived is a fact about the world, so it is declared here, one entry per archived file, and the manifest generator reads it. An archived file with no entry here is reported as a PROBLEM by `tools/inbox_manifest.py check`, never silently blanked.
